title: Monotonicity of reachability under edge addition
statement: Fix $n$, let $e_1$ and $e_2$ be lists of weighted edges on the vertex set $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$, and let $u, v : \mathrm{Fin}\,n$. Suppose $u$ and $v$ are connected by a path through the edges of $e_1$, and that every edge of $e_1$ also occurs in $e_2$. Then $u$ and $v$ are connected by a path through the edges of $e_2$.
hypotheses_covered: u and v are reachable through the edges of e1
every edge of e1 also belongs to e2
replaced:
If $\mathtt{Reach}\,e_1\,u\,v$ and every edge of $e_1$ also belongs to $e_2$, then
$\mathtt{Reach}\,e_2\,u\,v$.
